title: Eve's LITE
description: A small pack that does the do.
body:
Eve's LITE is a small little modpack dedicated to those who wish to have a modded experience with fully functional controller support. LITE [the Modrinth edition] contains tons of unique mods you wouldn't really see in most packs, with the most notable names being Farmer's Delight, Terralith, Better Combat, and Simply Swords. There's a huge focus on utilizing mods that you probably haven't played before: Hopo's mods [Better Mineshaft and Ruined Portals] make vanilla structures more intricate and fun to explore, Friends & Foes bringing voted against mobs from the mob vote into the spotlight, and a ton of QOL and special equipment and weapons mods like Enderite, Dragon Loot, and plenty of Fuzs' mods!

For those with a Steam Deck, this is currently being tested in order for peak performance to be achieved, the aim is to at least get 60fps in Singleplayer with specific shaders.

Recommended RAM: 6-8GB [Subject to change in due time during development phase]
